name: Run build and lint via shell
prompt: Run `cargo check` and `cargo clippy` in the shell to check this project for compilation errors and lint warnings. Report whether the project compiles cleanly, and list any warnings or errors you find.
expected_behavior: Agent runs cargo check and cargo clippy via exec/shell. Reports compilation success and any clippy warnings. In daimonos mode, L1 redirect intercepts these cargo commands and returns structured JSON from the cargo plugin.
